newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU cereals advisory panel to discuss crop, market.
newsitem.headline: EU cereals advisory panel to discuss crop, market.

text.p: The European Union's cereals advisory committee will discuss on Friday 1996 grain harvest estimates and management of the 1996/97 market, a trade source told Reuters on Thursday.
The committee is made up of traders, producers and consumer and labour representatives.
The committee will be given the latest crop forecast revised on Thursday by COCERAL, the European grain traders umbrella organisation, the source said.
The committee will also discuss European Commission proposals to cut arable area aid payments and changes to penalties for overshooting base area planting limits.
"We also expect a detailed discussion on modification of the (EU's) inward processing relief system.
"There is a demand by industry for simplifying what has become a bureaucratic system involving complicated controls and documentation," the source said.
Under the inward processing relief system, processors can claim relief from import duties for materials which are later re-exported as products.
